review_evidence: README and LSpec/LSpec.lean identify LSpec as a Lean testing framework inspired by Hspec/QuickCheck, providing unit tests and compile-time/runtime property testing.
A complete scan of all 13 Lean files found 143 declaration-style lines but only one theorem/lemma/axiom/example-style line, an instance-inference example in Examples/Examples.lean.

The core declarations implement Testable/TestSeq, random/sample generation, test composition and reporting; they do not state an independent mathematical theory, object-language semantics, or correctness development.

source_action.content_invariant: Across the 13 Lean files, the formal content is the machinery of a general-purpose testing framework; the lone proposition-style example is an instance-inference demonstration. Retiring the source therefore removes no independent mathematical theorem/proof, specification, or formal-semantics corpus.
